description: The median of three photographed stations places the plane of the middle upper window approximately 5.05 m to the right of and 45.66 m behind the midpoint of the street piers. The transverse facade width of 8.8 m is a scale assumption. Widths of 7.6–10.2 m give viewing distances of approximately 51–69 m. The three-station source and range calculations are in courtyard-range-check.json.
